annotations.title: Capture a screenshot of a web page

description: Loads a public web page in a headless browser and captures it as a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, or as a PDF. Returns a link to the file, and the image itself when it is small enough to look at directly. Suited to checking how a page renders or keeping a visual record of it.

delay.description: Seconds to wait after the page has loaded before capturing, 0 to 15. Default 5.

format.description: Output type. `jpeg` (default), `png`, `webp`, or `pdf` for a paged document.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels, 150 to 4320. Values outside the range are clamped. Default 1024.

marginBottom.description: PDF only. Bottom margin in inches, 0 to 5. Default 0.4.

marginLeft.description: PDF only. Left margin in inches, 0 to 5. Default 0.4.

marginRight.description: PDF only. Right margin in inches, 0 to 5. Default 0.4.

marginTop.description: PDF only. Top margin in inches, 0 to 5. Default 0.4.

paperHeight.description: PDF only. Paper height in inches.

paperWidth.description: PDF only. Paper width in inches.

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Sent as 80 when omitted, which keeps most captures small enough to be returned inline. Ignored for other formats.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to capture.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels, 200 to 3840. Values outside the range are clamped. Default 1280.

name: capture_screenshot
title: Capture a screenshot of a web page
